map.下降率 = 真空速 × sin(航迹角)。: Descent rate = true airspeed × sin(flight path angle).
map.进近常用 3° 下滑角。: Approaches commonly use a 3° glide path.
map.进近着陆时，由真空速 V 与航迹角 γ（下负）算下降率 ROC=−V·sinγ。: On approach and landing, compute the descent rate ROC=−V·sinγ from the true airspeed V and the flight path angle γ (negative on descent).
map.按稳定进近 3° 下滑角核算下降率，匹配 ILS/目视进近。: Compute the descent rate for a steady 3° approach glide path, matching ILS/visual approaches.
map.已知允许下降率（如 1000 ft/min），反推需要的真空速或航迹角。: Given an allowable descent rate (such as 1000 ft/min), back-calculate the required true airspeed or flight path angle.
map.3° 稳定进近下降率: Descent rate for a 3° steady approach
map.真空速 V=80 m/s、航迹角 γ=−3°。下降率 ROC = −80×sin: True airspeed V=80 m/s and flight path angle γ=−3°. Descent rate ROC = −80×sin(−3°)= −80×(−0.0523)=4.19 m/s ≈ 825 ft/min. Within the common 700-1000 ft/min steady approach range.
map.下降率和爬升率符号相反吗？: Do descent rate and climb rate have opposite signs?
map.是，爬升为正、下降为负（按升力方向定义）。进近时关注绝对值（下降快慢），过大说明: Yes, climb is positive and descent negative (defined along the lift direction). On approach you watch the absolute value (how fast the descent is); too large means the sink rate exceeds standard and needs a power reduction or a back-pressure correction.
map.真空速和地速影响下降率吗？: Do true airspeed and ground speed affect the descent rate?
map.本公式用真空速算相对空气的下沉率；相对地面的下沉还受风影响。进近监控以雷达/无线: This formula uses true airspeed to compute the sink rate relative to the air; the sink relative to the ground is also affected by wind. Approach monitoring uses the descent rate from radar/radio altimeter.
